title: 📊 Phân tích ngắn về chuyển động giá EPS gần đây
subTitle:
#EPS #BTC #ETH 
Thời gian vừa qua, EPS có xu hướng biến động theo dòng tiền DeFi và hệ sinh thái BNB Chain hơn là tự tạo sóng riêng.
🔎 1️⃣ Động lực tăng giá
Khi hệ DeFi trên BNB Chain sôi động, TVL tăng, EPS thường hưởng lợi nhờ vai trò token quản trị và nhận phí.
Những giai đoạn BTC ổn định hoặc altcoin season, dòng tiền hay tìm đến các coin vốn hoá nhỏ như EPS → biên độ tăng thường khá “gắt”.
Thanh khoản không quá lớn nên chỉ cần volume tăng đột biến là giá dễ bật mạnh.
⚠️ 2️⃣ Rủi ro
EPS thuộc nhóm DeFi đời cũ → narrative không còn quá mới.
Nếu dòng tiền rút khỏi BNB Chain hoặc thị trường bước vào pha risk-off, EPS thường giảm khá nhanh.
Tokenomics cần theo dõi kỹ (unlock, phát hành thêm).
📈 3️⃣ Góc nhìn cấu trúc giá
EPS thường có đặc điểm:
• Sideway dài
• Sau đó pump nhanh khi có volume
• Rồi điều chỉnh mạnh
👉Đây là kiểu cấu trúc phù hợp với trader thích bắt sóng ngắn hơn là hold dài hạn.
👉Nếu bạn đang trade Futures giống phong cách bạn theo đuổi (price action + quản lý vốn chặt), EPS thuộc dạng coin nên:
• Chỉ vào khi có breakout rõ ràng kèm volume
• Tránh FOMO khi đã tăng 20–30% trong ngày

title: Vitalik Buterin Proposes AI Stewards to Revolutionize DAO Governance on Ethereum
subTitle:
Vitalik Buterin just proposed a game-changing upgrade for DAO governance on Ethereum: deploying personal AI stewards that vote privately on your behalf using cutting-edge privacy tech.
This isn't sci-fi—it's a practical fix for one of Web3's biggest headaches: low voter turnout, coercion risks, bribery, and slow, centralized decision-making in decentralized organizations. Shared directly on X, the idea is already lighting up discussions in Ethereum circles, AI communities, and governance nerds alike. Here's the full breakdown of why this could be Ethereum's next big catalyst in 2026.

Vitalik's AI Stewards Proposal – What It Actually Means
Vitalik outlined using AI agents trained on your personal values, preferences, and past voting history to act as "stewards" in DAOs. These agents would:
Cast votes privately without revealing your identity or preferences.
Protect against vote-buying, coercion, or targeted influence.
Scale governance for massive DAOs where human participation drops off.
To make it secure and private, he'd layer in proven tools like:
Zero-knowledge proofs (ZK) → Prove a vote was cast correctly without showing what it was.Secure multi-party computation (MPC) → Let multiple parties compute together without leaking data.Trusted execution environments (TEEs) → Hardware-secured enclaves for running code privately.
The result? DAOs could become truly scalable, resistant to manipulation, and more democratic—even for huge communities. In a world where most DAO proposals see <10% turnout, this could flip the script and make Ethereum the undisputed king of decentralized orgs.
Why This Matters Right Now in 2026
Ethereum's price sits around $1,970–$1,980 (as of February 22), down sharply YTD amid broader market fear (Fear & Greed at extreme lows like 9). Bitcoin hovers near $68,000, with heavy ETF outflows but signs of institutional dip-buying.
While meme coins like Solana's PUNCH (up massively on viral hype) grab short-term headlines, Vitalik's proposal taps into real utility:
AI + crypto crossover is exploding—projects like Bittensor (TAO) and Render are pumping on decentralized intelligence narratives.
DAOs manage billions in assets but struggle with governance; fixing that drives ETH demand for gas, staking, and layer-2 scaling.
Privacy tech (ZK, MPC) is maturing fast—Ethereum leads here, positioning it ahead of competitors.
If adopted (even partially), this could spark renewed developer activity, higher ETH usage in DAOs, and fresh narratives around "Ethereum 2.0 governance era." It's the kind of foundational upgrade that compounds quietly then explodes during sentiment shifts.
Bottom Line: Watch Closely
Vitalik's AI stewards idea isn't just theory—it's a blueprint to make DAOs actually work for millions. If it gains traction (via EIPs, test implementations, or big DAO pilots), it could reignite Ethereum's narrative as the smart contract platform of the future.
Bullish contrarian signal in a fearful market? Absolutely. Keep ETH on radar—governance evolution could be the sleeper hit of 2026.

Ethereum Is Quiet… But The Order Book Isn’t

Ethereum is still trading ~60% below its most recent ATH, stuck inside a tight $1,900–$2,150 compression range.

On the surface?

Looks like standard consolidation.

Underneath?

Liquidity dynamics are shifting.

ETF Outflows = Cooling Institutional Appetite

On February 19 alone, spot ETH ETFs saw ~66,000 ETH in outflows (~$130M).

ETF flows don’t move price instantly — but they reveal positioning intent.

Sustained outflows typically signal:

• Reduced conviction

• Portfolio de-risking

• Tactical allocation shifts

Not necessarily distribution — but definitely not aggressive accumulation.

Binance Order Size Is Shrinking

On Binance, the average ETH order size has been declining steadily this year.

That implies:

• Whale participation thinning

• Large bids interacting less

• Softer market depth

• Lower liquidity resilience

This is important.

It doesn’t scream “sell-off.”

It whispers “disengagement.”

And disengagement weakens structural support during volatility events.

Retail Still Active — But That’s Not Enough

Total volume remains relatively stable.

So:

✔ Retail hasn’t disappeared

✔ Range traders are active

✔ Short-term flows still rotate

But small orders can’t absorb large imbalances like whale-sized bids can.

When depth disappears, price moves faster.

The Tension Setup

Low whale participation

Stable retail activity

Tight range compression

= Volatility coil.

Two outcomes:

1- Whales Re-Engage

Liquidity thickens

Range breaks upward

Conviction returns

2- Selling Hits Thin Books

Liquidity gaps form

Breakdown accelerates

Volatility expands fast

Compression rarely lasts forever.

What Actually Matters

It’s not sentiment.

It’s not Twitter narratives.

It’s depth.

If larger participants step back into the order book, structure stabilizes.

If they don’t — fragility increases.

Ethereum doesn’t need hype right now.

It needs whales.

title: 虚拟货币是否正在取代传统金融？Web3，真的是下一个互联网风口吗？
subTitle:
2026年初的达沃斯论坛上，风向彻底改变了。曾经被边缘化的“加密小屋”，如今成为全球政商精英讨论的核心议题。贝莱德CEO Larry Fink明确倡导将整个金融系统迁移到“共同区块链”上，Coinbase CEO透露全球前十大银行已将加密货币视为“关乎生存的问题”。这些信号指向一个清晰结论：虚拟货币不是在与传统金融并存，而是在加速取代它的底层架构
             取代，从最核心的支付开始
        稳定币正在成为全球支付的“新标准”。截至2025年底，全球稳定币市值突破3100亿美元，在加密市场整体下跌的背景下逆势增长50%。Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire在达沃斯指出，稳定币采用已达到“临界速度”，正从根本上重塑全球金融体系的底层架构。
        为什么是取代而非补充？因为区块链支付的效率是降维打击：24/7全天候运行、100%储备金透明、结算时间从数天降至数秒。西门子报告显示，使用区块链结算的外汇节省达50%。当成本和时间都碾压传统体系，“取代”只是时间问题。
                主权国家与华尔街的全面入场
        2025年，美国政府建立了“战略比特币储备”，将罚没比特币长期持有而非拍卖；同时允许401(k)养老金在合规前提下配置加密资产，打开了万亿美元资金入市的大门。
        更关键的是RWA（现实世界资产代币化）的爆发。目前已有超过十个国家的政府积极探索将国家级资产上链。赵长鹏透露，他正与十多个国家政府探讨资产代币化方案。这不是“尝试”，而是国家财政基础设施的迁移——主权信用正在从纸质债券转向数字代币。
               Web3：从投机叙事到价值交付
       Web3正经历从“技术沙盒”到“结构重整”的质变。SNZ与南洋理工发布的《2026年区块链十大趋势》指出，Web3已从早期的投机实验，迈向可验证的金融基础设施。
       XREX集团萧滙宗用一句话点破本质：“2026年，不懂金融逻辑的人，比不懂区块链更危险。”这意味着Web3不再是极客的游戏，而是金融精英的主场。去中心化金融不再试图推翻中心化体系，而是补上中心化机构不愿服务的“制度性裂缝”。
        CoinShares报告将2026年定义为“实用性获胜之年”——数字资产不再试图建立平行金融体系，而是直接升级现有的传统系统。当传统金融选择用区块链重写自己的底层代码，这就是最彻底的“取代”。
       虚拟货币正在取代传统金融——不是通过颠覆，而是通过吸纳。当贝莱德将代币化视为金融系统的未来，当主权国家将财政资产搬上链，当稳定币成为跨境结算的首选，旧的金融形态正在被新的技术底座替换。
       Web3，确实是下一个互联网风口。但这个风口不再属于投机者，而属于那些既懂技术逻辑、更懂金融规则的建设者。正如达沃斯传递的基调：数字资产已正式穿越风暴眼，成为全球经济不可逆转的一部分。真正的“大时代”，刚刚开始。$BTC #ETH

title: When a Founder Sells: Reading Vitalik’s $8M ETH Move Through Market Structure, Not Emotion
subTitle:
The headline writes itself.
Vitalik Buterin sold around $8 million in ETH.
For many investors, that triggers one instinct: Is he exiting?
That reaction is understandable. Founder selling always creates short-term fear. It feels personal. If the builder is selling, what does he know that we don’t?
But markets don’t move on feelings. They move on structure.
Let’s start with context.
Ethereum today operates in a mature market. Circulating supply sits above 120 million ETH. Daily trading volume runs in the billions. Liquidity is deep across centralized exchanges and on-chain venues. This is no longer a thin, early-stage token environment where a few thousand coins can destabilize price.
Against that backdrop, Vitalik holds roughly 240,000 ETH. That sounds large in isolation. It isn’t in structural terms. It represents a fraction of total supply, roughly around 0.2 percent.
More importantly, his holdings have declined gradually over years.
End of 2021: around 330,000 ETH.
End of 2022: around 250,000 ETH.
End of 2023: around 246,000 ETH.
End of 2024: around 240,000 ETH.
End of 2025: still around 240,000 ETH.
That is not liquidation behavior. That is controlled, periodic reduction.
Now look at the recent activity.
In late January, over 16,000 ETH were moved to another wallet. Not sold. Reserved for multi-year funding.
In early February, a few thousand ETH were sold across several days. Structured batches. Not one large market order.
On February 22, 3,500 ETH were withdrawn from Aave. Only a portion was sold.
Then today, around $8 million worth of ETH was sold.
These were swaps. Not aggressive exchange dumps.
That distinction matters.
When someone wants out fast, they hit centralized exchanges hard. Size shows up quickly in order books. Slippage expands. Fear accelerates.
That’s not what we are seeing.
Instead, the pattern aligns with history. Since 2018, Vitalik has publicly stated he does not sell ETH for personal enrichment. Past movements have typically been tied to donations, research funding, biotech initiatives like Kanro, and broader ecosystem support.
The behavior fits the precedent.
Now zoom out further.
Ethereum is no longer dependent on one individual. It has a global developer base, decentralized validators, Layer 2 ecosystems, institutional exposure, staking participation, and an active DeFi economy.
Founder behavior matters symbolically. It matters far less structurally than it did in 2017.
Compare this to true red flags.
If we were seeing tens of thousands of ETH sent directly to centralized exchanges within hours, that would be different. If holdings dropped by 50 percent in a short window, that would signal something else.
A few thousand ETH sold gradually in a 120 million supply system does not meet that threshold.
Psychology, however, amplifies perception.
Retail traders often react to identity signals. “Founder sold” becomes shorthand for “something is wrong.” That emotional shortcut creates volatility. But volatility is not the same as structural weakness.
The more important question is intent and scale.
Scale: small relative to market depth.
Intent: consistent with historical funding behavior.
Structure: no evidence of panic liquidation.
That does not mean ignore it. It means interpret it correctly.
Markets reward those who differentiate between noise and regime change.
Right now, the data suggests funding rotation, not abandonment.
You don’t have to like founder selling. It can still create short-term pressure. It can still trigger narratives.
But numbers matter more than narratives.
Ethereum’s supply structure remains intact. Liquidity remains deep. Vitalik remains one of the largest individual holders of ETH.
This does not look like an exit.
It looks like allocation.
And in mature systems, allocation is normal.
This is not financial advice. Always verify current prices and conduct independent research.

content:
Why #ETH price pumps ??
Here are the main reasons why ETH (Ethereum) pumps 👇

---

1️⃣ Bitcoin Moves First

When Bitcoin rises strongly, money usually flows into altcoins next — and Ethereum is the biggest altcoin.
👉 BTC pump → Investors take profit → Move funds to ETH → ETH pumps.

---

2️⃣ ETF & Institutional Buying

Spot Ethereum ETFs (like those approved in the U.S.) bring institutional money.
When big funds accumulate ETH, demand increases → price goes up.

---

3️⃣ Network Upgrades (Bullish Fundamentals)

Ethereum upgrades improve scalability and lower fees.
Example:

Ethereum 2.0 (shift to Proof of Stake)

Dencun Upgrade (reduced Layer-2 costs)

Upgrades = stronger ecosystem = investor confidence.

---

4️⃣ DeFi & Layer 2 Growth

Most DeFi apps run on Ethereum.
When DeFi activity increases, more ETH is used for gas → higher demand.

Popular ecosystems:

Arbitrum

Optimism

More users = more ETH usage = bullish pressure.

---

5️⃣ ETH Burning (Supply Reduction)

After EIP-1559, part of transaction fees is burned.
If network usage is high → more#ETH🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥  burned → supply decreases → price can rise.

---

6️⃣ Whale Accumulation

When large wallets buy millions worth of #ETH🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥 , supply on exchanges decreases → price pumps.

---

7️⃣ Market Hype / FOMO

Social media, influencers, and breakout technical patterns can trigger fast retail buying.

---

🔥 Simple Summary

ETH pumps because of: ✔ BTC bullish trend
✔ Institutional buying
✔ Network upgrades
✔ DeFi growth
✔ Supply burn
✔ Whale activity

---

content:
The Crypto Suitcase With No Handle 🧳

I had a thought today. How many coins are sitting in your wallet right now that you KNOW are never coming back? Be honest — we've all got them.

But what do we do? We hold. We hope. We tell ourselves "it'll bounce back, just one more week." This isn't strategy — it's psychology. It's called Loss Aversion: the pain of losing $100 feels twice as strong as the joy of gaining $100. So we'd rather hold a dead coin to zero than lock in a loss and move on.

The numbers don't lie: 11.6 million tokens died in 2025 alone — that's 53% of all crypto ever created. $TIA  went from $7 to $0.50. The entire GameFi sector ($AXS , $GALA , $SAND ) lost 75%. And yes, even $PEPE is sitting at -85% from ATH right now.

So what's the move? Simple but painful: take responsibility, cut the loss, sell for whatever you can get, and redeploy that capital into something alive. Then analyze what went wrong so you don't repeat it.

Money is like water — it needs to flow. If it stops, it turns into a swamp. Don't let your wallet become a swamp of dead coins. 🏚️

title: ETHEREUM (ETH): THE CALM BEFORE THE ROTATION
subTitle:
Market State: Structural Re-Accumulation

If you look at the charts, ETH looks "boring" compared to the high-speed volatility of Solana or the meme-coin frenzy. But under the hood, the most significant wealth transfer in this cycle is happening right now.

1. Price & Vital Signs
Current Price: ~$3,150 – $3,220
24h Change: +0.4% (Neutral/Consolidation)
ETH/BTC Ratio: 0.034 (Testing a multi-year support zone)
The Narrative: We are currently in the "Laggard Phase." Historically, money flows from BTC → ETH → Large Caps → Small Caps. We are in the final seconds of the BTC dominance phase.
2. The "Blob" Efficiency & Burn Rate
The market is finally starting to price in the post-Dencun reality.

L2 Dominance: Transactions on Base, Arbitrum, and Optimism have hit a combined 20 million per day.
The Misunderstood Metric: Total ETH "burn" is lower than 2021, but Total Value Locked (TVL) is at a 3-year high.
The Insight: Ethereum is no longer selling "expensive blockspace" to retail; it is selling "security and finality" to Layer 2s. The revenue is more stable, more institutional, and less prone to "crash-and-burn" cycles.
3. The Staking "Black Hole"
One of the biggest updates today is the Staking Ratio.

Roughly 32% of all ETH is now locked in staking or restaking (EigenLayer).
Institutional Locking: Large entities aren't just holding ETH; they are "yield farming" it through Spot ETFs that have finally enabled staking rewards in early 2026.
The Result: The "Available Supply" on exchanges is at its lowest point in history. When the rotation finally starts, there will be very little ETH available to buy, leading to a "God Candle" (a massive, sudden price spike).
4. Technical Outlook: The Coil
ETH is currently trapped in a massive Symmetrical Triangle on the weekly chart.

Support: $3,000 (The Psychological Floor).
Resistance: $3,500 (The Multi-month Ceiling).
The Trigger: A daily close above $3,500 will likely signal the start of the "ETH Season," where it begins to outperform Bitcoin on a percentage basis.
The Verdict
State: Maximum Opportunity / Minimum Hype. Outlook: High-conviction hold.

Strategy: Smart money is currently "Front-running the Rotation." While retail is chasing the $100k BTC headline, the "Pain Trade" is being long on ETH. The risk-to-reward ratio for ETH at $3,200 is arguably better than BTC at $94,000 for those looking for the next 2x move.

"Ethereum isn't failing; it's maturing. The market is mistaking stability for weakness. In crypto, the longest periods of boredom lead to the most violent moves upward. Respect the foundation.

Сегодня Ethereum (ETH) открылся на уровне 1973 долларов США. Он снизился на -1,21% по сравнению с ценой открытия. Несмотря на рост до уровня 1982 долларов США, Ethereum (ETH) столкнулся с сопротивлением и не смог удержать импульс для дальнейшего роста. С момента достижения максимальной цены за последние 30 и 7 дней его стоимость снизилась на -36,21% и -7,26% , а с момента достижения минимальной цены за тот же период он вырос на 10,74% и 1,83% .

📣 Vitalik Buterin Sold Ethereum ($ETH ) Again

Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin once again drew attention to the selling side with his transactions today.

According to on-chain data, Buterin sold a total of 428.57 ETH, acquiring approximately $850,178 worth of stablecoin GHO. The transactions appear to have been conducted via the decentralized exchange protocol CoW Protocol.

With this latest sale, it is estimated that Buterin has sold a total of 7,386 ETH since February 2nd, for approximately $15.51 million, at an average price of $2,100. This data indicates that the founder has been making sales at regular intervals in recent weeks.

On-chain records show that the transactions were made through a Gnosis Safe Proxy wallet belonging to Buterin. Some of the ETH was first converted to WETH, and then swapped to GHO. GHO is known as a collateralized stablecoin issued by the Aave ecosystem.

The data also shows a movement of approximately 3,500 WETH (approximately $6.9 million). This transfer appears to be linked to assets withdrawn from an aEthWETH position on Aave V3 and transferred to the wallet. However, it is unclear whether this transaction was a direct sale or position management.

According to Arkham data, the total value of assets attributed to Vitalik Buterin across 10 different addresses is approximately $468 million.

title: ETH vs ETC: The Split That Changed Crypto Forever (And Why It’s NOT Another LUNA Story)
subTitle:
Every cycle, the same rumor comes back:🌀
“$ETH is just the new version. $ETC is the old one. Just like $LUNC and #LUNC .”
Sounds dramatic.But it’s wrong.
Let’s clear this up properly.🫵
It All Started With a Hack 🔰
Back in 2016, a project called The DAO raised a massive amount of #ETH . It was one of the earliest experiments in decentralized investing on Ethereum.
Then it got hacked.
Around $60M worth of ETH was drained. Panic hit the ecosystem. The community had a choice:
Do nothing and respect “code is law”
Or change the blockchain history to return the funds
That decision split Ethereum into two chains.

The Fork That Created Two Worlds 💊
The majority chose to reverse the hack. That chain became today’s Ethereum (ETH).
A minority refused to rewrite history. They continued running the original chain — now called Ethereum Classic (ETC).
Same origin.
Different philosophy.
ETH moved forward with upgrades, innovation, and massive ecosystem growth.
ETC stayed loyal to immutability above all else.
Both survived. But one clearly dominated.🤩
Why This Is NOT Like LUNA & LUNC 🧐
When #TerraLabs collapsed, it wasn’t about ideology.
It was a death spiral.
Its algorithmic stablecoin imploded. Billions were wiped out. Trust evaporated. The chain basically burned down.
After that:
The old chain became Terra Classic (LUNC)
A brand new chain launched as Terra 2.0 (LUNA)
That was a reset after catastrophe.
Ethereum was different. It didn’t collapse. It didn’t depeg. It didn’t restart from zero.
It split over principle — not failure.

The Real Takeaway 🤔
ETH and ETC are siblings from the same origin story.
LUNA and LUNC are survivors of a system that broke.
If you understand that difference, you understand a big piece of crypto history.
And in this market, knowing the story behind the chart matters more than most people think.

title: Хакер взломал криптомост IoTeX и вывел почти $9 млн
subTitle:
Сначала хакер вывел из хранилища криптоактивы примерно на $4,3 млн: USDC, USDT, IOTX, PAYG, WBTC и BUSD. Средства были изъяты напрямую, а не через уязвимость смарт‑контракта, уточнил ончейн‑аналитик под ником Specter. 

Общий ущерб мог достичь $8,8 млн, хотя представители IoTeX оспаривают эти цифры.
{future}(IOTXUSDT)
Хакер оперативно замаскировал следы кражи. Он обменял выведенные активы на эфир через децентрализованные биржи, включая Uniswap, а затем перевел около 45 ETH в сеть Биткоина через кроссчейн‑мост. Для перемещения средств между сетями злоумышленник использовал THORChain. 
После этого неизвестный воспользовался скомпрометированными контрактами для выпуска около 111 млн токенов CIOTX (на $4 млн), которые используются IoTeX для обеспечения ликвидности в протоколе DePIN. Благодаря CIOTX дополнительно было выведено 9,3 млн токенов CCS на сумму около $4,5 млн. 

Платформа IoTeX подтвердила инцидент. Сооснователь и генеральный директор Рауллен Чай (Raullen Chai) сообщил , что централизованные биржи сотрудничают с проектом для отслеживания и заморозки средств. Сейчас блокчейн IoTeX временно отключен. Первоначальная оценка ущерба самой платформой составляет около $2 млн. Чай утверждает, что токены CCS и некоторые другие давно устарели и не имеют ценности, а CIOTX заморожен и команда работает над тем, чтобы хакер не смог переместить активы. $IOTX $BTC $ETH #IOTX #BTC #ETH #Write2Earn

title: Ethereum Staking Demand Falls 50% – ETH Price in More Trouble?
subTitle:
The $ETH price action has not inspired much confidence recently. It has stayed mostly flat over the past 24 hours and remains down over 5% in the past seven days. Yet a small recovery attempt is underway. Since February 19, Ethereum has rebounded about 4.5%, helped by a bullish divergence on the daily chart.
This signal usually suggests that selling pressure is weakening. But at the same time, a sharp drop in staking demand is raising a new question. Is returning liquidity quietly building pressure against this recovery?
Bullish Divergence Appears, Yet Falling Staking Demand May Be Returning Supply
Ethereum’s recent rebound began after a bullish divergence formed between February 15 and February 19. A bullish divergence occurs when the price makes a lower low while the Relative Strength Index (RSI) makes a higher low. RSI is a momentum indicator that shows whether selling or buying pressure is stronger.
When RSI improves while price falls, it often signals that sellers are losing strength, allowing a rebound to begin. This is why $ETH managed to recover from its February 6 low near $1,740 and climb back toward $1,970, at press time.

However, while the chart signaled recovery, Ethereum’s staking data, compiled exclusively by BeInCrypto analysts, began to show the opposite trend.
Staking means locking ETH inside the network to help secure Ethereum and earn rewards. When #ETH is staked, it reduces the liquid supply because those coins cannot be easily sold.
But when demand falls, that supply can return to the market and increase selling risk.
Ethereum’s 6-month cumulative net staking deposits dropped from 1,994,282 ETH on January 13 to 1,008,012 ETH on February 22. This is a decline of about 986,000 ETH, or nearly 50%.

This sharp drop means far less ETH is being absorbed into staking. This allows more ETH to remain liquid or available in the market. This creates a direct conflict.
The bullish divergence suggests recovery, but falling staking demand suggests liquidity is returning. So the key question becomes clear.
Where is this returning ETH going?
Exchange Balances And Whale Selling Show Liquidity Is Already Moving
Exchange balance data provides the first clue. Ethereum balances on exchanges recently rose from 14,241,203 ETH to 14,586,720 ETH. This is an increase of about 345,500 #ETH , or roughly 2.4%, in a short time.
Exchange balances measure how much ETH is available on trading platforms. When this number rises, it usually means more ETH is available to sell.
This level is especially important because it matches levels last seen on February 4.
At that time, Ethereum’s price fell sharply from $2,140 to $1,820 in just one day, a drop of nearly 15%. This shows how rising exchange supply can quickly translate into selling pressure.

The timing also aligns closely with the staking decline, confirming that falling staking demand is contributing to rising liquid supply.
ETH whale behavior is reinforcing this trend. Whales are large holders whose buying and selling can influence price direction. Since February 19, whale holdings have dropped from 113.65 million ETH to 113.42 million ETH.
This means whales sold about 230,000 ETH in just three days. This selling happened while Ethereum was attempting to recover.

This suggests that instead of supporting the rebound, large holders are possibly using the existing or increased liquidity to reduce their positions. This combination of rising exchange balances and whale selling shows that liquidity is not just returning. It is already creating resistance.
Cost Basis Clusters Show Why the Ethereum Price Recovery Faces Immediate Resistance
On-chain cost basis data now explains where this resistance may appear. Cost basis represents the price levels at which investors previously bought their ETH. When prices return to these levels, many holders try to sell at breakeven, creating resistance unless a reason to hold emerges.
This data comes from the #UTXO Realized Price Distribution, or URPD. Although Ethereum uses an account-based system, this metric has been adapted to estimate Ethereum’s supply distribution.
It shows that more than 2% of Ethereum’s supply is concentrated between $2,020 and $2,070. These levels also align closely with resistance levels on Ethereum’s price chart.

This creates a critical test. If #Ethereum recovery continues, it must break above $2,050 first and then challenge the $2,140 level. A stronger move could extend toward $2,300.
But because supply is concentrated near $2,020 and $2,070, many holders may sell as ETH approaches these levels. This makes $2,050 the most crucial zone in the short term.
With staking demand falling and whales already selling, absorbing this supply (if it unlocks when the price hits a key level) becomes difficult without strong new demand.

On the downside, the key support level sits at $1,890. This level sits about 4% below the current price. If this support fails, Ethereum could fall back toward its February low near $1,740.
This places $ETH in a risky position. The bullish divergence has opened the door for recovery. But falling staking demand, rising exchange balances, whale selling, and strong cost-basis resistance suggest that returning liquidity may determine what happens next.

title: A Trader’s View from the Screen Not the Banner.
subTitle:
$BTC When I first saw the banner about joining Binance to grab a share of a 10.5 million SENT prize pool I didn’t click immediately. Not because the number was small or big, but because promotions only matter to me after I’ve watched how the market behaves around them. As a trader I’ve learned that the real story always shows up on the chart and in the order book, not in the headline.

In my trading sessions during similar events, what stood out wasn’t excitement but a subtle shift in execution quality. As volume started building ahead of the campaign window fills became slightly less predictable. Not broken not dramatic just enough delay and slippage to remind me that crowded moments change the rules. That’s usually my first signal to slow down, not speed up.

When volatility picked up, liquidity looked deep on the surface. The book was stacked spreads looked fine, and price seemed stable. But once larger orders hit, I noticed liquidity thinning faster than expected. Orders were there, but they didn’t always stay. This is something you only notice when you’re actually trading size not watching candles. It tells me that some participants are passive until pressure arrives, then they step aside.

What I also noticed is how execution reliability shifts during these promotional surges. Most trades still go through cleanly but the margin for error narrows. A market order that feels harmless in quiet hours can suddenly cost more than planned. During one spike, I reduced position size instead of widening stops. That decision wasn’t technical; it was based on feel. When the tape speeds up protecting entry quality matters more than chasing range.

One thing that often breaks under stress is confidence in short-term signals. Indicators still print, patterns still form but the reaction time changes. Moves happen faster and reversals are sharper. In those moments I rely less on indicators and more on how price reacts to obvious levels. If a level breaks without follow-through I step back. That behavior tends to repeat during campaign driven volume.

A less discussed observation is how trader psychology shifts during these events. Promotions attract newer flow and that changes rhythm. You start seeing clusters of similar entries, similar exits. The market feels more crowded, almost noisy. For me, that’s usually a sign to trade less frequently but with clearer intent. Fewer trades, better context.

Liquidity behavior also tells a story after the initial hype fades. Once the first wave passes, spreads normalize, but volume doesn’t disappear completely. There’s often a middle phase where activity stays elevated yet price goes sideways. That’s where impatience creeps in. I’ve seen many traders overtrade this zone, mistaking activity for opportunity. I usually do the opposite and wait.

During one session I noticed that partial fills became more common than usual. Not enough to cause problems, but enough to require attention. I started placing limits slightly earlier than planned, accepting that I might miss some trades. Missing a trade during high participation periods is often cheaper than forcing one.

From a practical standpoint my judgment during these campaigns is simple. I treat them as stress tests not opportunities by default. If execution stays clean and reactions are orderly, I participate. If not I scale down. The prize pool doesn’t change my risk model; the market conditions do.

Another subtle point is how timeframes compress. Moves that usually take hours can happen in minutes. That doesn’t mean trends are stronger; it means decisions need to be quicker or avoided entirely. I often shift to higher timeframes during these windows, even if I’m an intraday trader by habit. It helps filter noise.

By the end of most promotional periods, my conclusion is usually balanced. These events don’t break the market, but they expose its edges. You see where liquidity is real and where it’s cosmetic. You feel how execution changes when participation spikes. And you learn something about your own discipline under pressure.

For me, the value isn’t in the banner or the prize pool. It’s in observing how the market behaves when many eyes are watching. Those lessons carry over long after the promotion ends. As traders, adapting to these conditions quietly and patiently is often more profitable than reacting loudly.

That’s how I approach it: observe first, trade second, and let the market show its hand before I play mine.

title:
Коли тиждень червоний.

І ти вже не питаєш «чому», ти питаєш «за що?» 😂
subTitle:
Спочатку ти: «Я зайшла по стратегії». Потім: «Ну, майже по стратегії». Потім: «Я зайшла, бо відчула ринок». І в кінці: «Я зайшла, бо мені стало сумно і я хотіла пригод» 😌 Ринок в цей момент такий: «Дякую за ліквідність» 😈
Зелені свічки зараз виглядають як:
— повідомлення, яке ти відкрила, але не відповіла і воно зникло😅
ROI? Який ROI… Ми зараз працюємо над внутрішнім ROI — Return Of Inner calm 😂
Найсмішніше в трейдингу — це коли ти вже доросла, розумна, дисциплінована людина… А потім дивишся на +2% і думаєш: «О, можна купити каву і почати нове життя».
А потім — бац — і знову червоне.
І ти така: «Ну добре. Я і не дуже любила каву» 😅
Але правда проста:
Я не борюсь з ринком.
Я не переконую графіки.
Я не пишу їм в особисті:
«Може повернешся?» 😂
Я просто торгую по плану.
І іноді плачу в душі, але це вже не фінансова стратегія, а життєва філософія😁.
Так, его хоче зелений скрін. Так, приємніше писати про плюс. Але зрілість — це коли ти спокійно визнаєш: "Так. Зараз червоне". Але я все одно спокійна. Без жадібності. Без паніки. Без спроб довести ринку, хто я.
Бо червоний екран — це не поразка. Це тренування витримки.
Тож треную витримку з думкою: «Я сильніша за цей тиждень… але ринок ще цього не знає»😂 🔥

When the market changes, they may become the "gods of the past." So don't fantasize; this world does not have any stable compound interest. title: Vitalik Buterin Extends ETH Sell-Off as Ethereum Struggles Below $2,000
subTitle:
Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has continued liquidating portions of his ETH holdings, drawing attention from market participants as Ethereum remains under pressure below the critical $2,000 price level.

According to on-chain data from Arkham Intelligence and Lookonchain, Buterin recently withdrew 3,500 ETH — valued at approximately $7 million — from the decentralized lending platform Aave. Shortly after the withdrawal, blockchain activity indicated that 571 ETH, worth around $1.13 million, had already been sold.

This move follows a broader selling pattern earlier in the month. On February 5, reports revealed that Buterin had sold nearly 2,961 ETH (around $6.6 million) within three days. By the next day, total sales had reached 6,183 ETH, valued at approximately $13.2 million, with an average selling price near $2,140 per token.

Despite these transactions, Buterin remains one of Ethereum’s largest individual holders. Prior to the latest transfers, his wallet reportedly contained over 240,000 ETH, worth roughly $467 million. The recent disposals therefore represent only a small fraction of his total holdings.

Ethereum Faces Technical Pressure

Ethereum has experienced significant volatility over the past year. After approaching $5,000 in late August, ETH reversed sharply and closed 2025 near $3,000. A strong market correction in late January and early February pushed prices below $1,800. Although partial recovery followed, ETH has yet to reclaim and sustain levels above $2,000.

Adding to bearish sentiment, analyst Ali Martinez recently highlighted a potentially negative technical pattern forming on Ethereum’s chart. The structure, described as an inverted bullish flag, suggests the possibility of further downside, with projected targets potentially falling below $1,400 if selling pressure continues.

Market Sentiment Remains Fragile

While it remains unclear whether Buterin’s continued ETH liquidation reflects personal financial management, portfolio diversification, or a broader strategic decision, the timing has amplified market speculation. Investors are closely watching Ethereum’s price action as it navigates a sensitive technical zone.

With macroeconomic uncertainty and ongoing volatility across crypto markets, Ethereum’s ability to defend key support levels in the coming weeks may determine its short-term direction.

title: Bitcoin see-saws around $68,000, DOGE, ETH slide as tariff uncertainty weighs on risk assets
subTitle:
President Donald Trump raised the global tariff rate to 15% despite a Supreme Court ruling against earlier emergency trade measures, keeping pressure on China and other partners.

Bitcoin slid back toward $67,000 in Sunday trading as trade uncertainty resurfaced, with investors weighing fresh tariff escalation against a shifting legal backdrop in the U.S.
BTC was trading around $67,526, down about 1.4% over the past 24 hours and roughly 2.1% on the week. The move follows President Donald Trump’s decision to raise the worldwide tariff rate to 15% from 10%, despite a recent Supreme Court ruling that invalidated earlier emergency trade measures.

The court’s decision had briefly appeared to limit Washington’s ability to deploy sweeping tariffs ahead of Trump’s planned March 31 visit to Beijing. Instead, the administration responded by lifting the global rate, keeping pressure on trade partners even as the legal footing remains contested.
China now faces the same 15% levy applied to U.S. allies, with that rate set against a 150-day window. Markets are left navigating both escalation and ambiguity, a combination that tends to dampen appetite for risk.

Losses were broad acorss crypto majors. Ether slipped 1.8% to $1,951 and is down 2.5% over the past week. XRP fell 4.4% on the day and 8.4% across seven days to $1.39. Solana dropped 3.8% in 24 hours to $83.25, while Dogecoin shed nearly 5% on the day and more than 11% on the week. Cardano declined 4.3%, and BNB eased 2.3%.
Trade friction is not confined to Asia. European lawmakers are signaling hesitation over advancing the so-called Turnberry Agreement, saying they want clearer commitments from Washington on trade policy before moving forward.
For now, crypto remains tightly linked to macro headlines. Until tariff policy finds firmer footing, digital assets are likely to move with broader risk sentiment rather than on purely crypto-native catalysts.

title: Ethereum Is Sitting at a Crossroads — And Most Traders Don’t See It
subTitle:
I’ve been watching $ETH  around the $1,900 zone, and this doesn’t feel like a random consolidation. It feels like a decision point.

Price hovering below $2,000 isn’t just a number on the chart. It’s psychological. Every time ETH tries to reclaim higher ground, momentum fades quickly. That tells me conviction isn’t strong — at least not yet.

And in this kind of environment, hesitation matters.

The $2,000 Line Isn’t Just Resistance

Technically, reclaiming $2,100–$2,300 would change short-term structure.

But emotionally, $2,000 is the real battlefield.

Above it, optimism starts returning.

Below it, doubt creeps in.

Right now, Ethereum is trading beneath that confidence zone. And markets that fail to reclaim key psychological levels often drift lower before they surprise anyone to the upside.

If $1,800 breaks decisively, I wouldn’t be shocked to see liquidity tested near $1,600. That’s where stronger buyers would likely step in.

The Macro Pressure Is Real

Tariff headlines, policy uncertainty, and regulatory debates like the CLARITY Act aren’t background noise — they shape capital flows.

Ethereum thrives when liquidity expands and risk appetite grows.

It struggles when capital becomes cautious.

And currently, risk appetite doesn’t look aggressive. It looks selective.

Institutional participation hasn’t vanished — but it isn’t accelerating either. Without expanding demand, rallies tend to stall.

The Narrative vs. The Chart

Long term, Ethereum still dominates:

Smart contracts
Real-world asset tokenization
DeFi infrastructure
Layer-2 growth

But markets don’t move on fundamentals alone. They move on timing.

Right now, the chart isn’t confirming the strength of the narrative. That mismatch creates vulnerability.

My Take

I’m not calling for collapse. Ethereum is too deeply embedded in crypto to dismiss casually.

But until ETH convincingly reclaims and holds above $2,100 with strong volume, I remain cautious.

The structure feels heavy.

Momentum feels fragile.

And patience feels more important than excitement.

My view: If $1,800 fails, Ethereum likely tests $1,600 before any serious recovery begins.

title: Bitcoin’s Quantum Risk Steals Spotlight At Ethereum Gathering
subTitle:
Talk of quantum computers no longer sounds like science fiction at crypto events. At a recent developer gathering, the ETH Denver, engineers and security researchers turned their attention to a simple but unsettling question: what happens to Bitcoin if a powerful quantum machine comes online?
Reports have disclosed that new proposals are being folded into the network’s improvement process, laying early groundwork for defenses before any real crisis appears.
Quantum Computing: Why Hashing Is Not The Main Fear
Hashing—what miners and many parts of the system use—gets faster only a bit with quantum tricks. According to Lov Grover’s work, a quantum search method gives a square-root speedup, which changes safety margins but does not wipe them out.
In plain language: to break hashes at scale would need enormous, maybe unrealistic, machines under current models.
Signatures Face The Real Risk
Reports say the bigger worry is signatures. “What we’re worried about in the next five years are signatures, and that goes over with Shor’s,” Hunter Beast, co-author of BIP 360, said during the ETH Denver gathering.
The math behind most wallets today relies on elliptic curves, and Peter Shor showed a way a quantum machine could reverse that math.
That’s how a public key could reveal a private key once the right hardware exists. A blockchain security firm has been tracking addresses that have already exposed their public keys, and the numbers are not tiny.
Blockchain cybersecurity firm Project Eleven’s list flags millions of coins that, if an attacker had a big enough quantum device, would be at risk.
$BTC #bitcoin 
{future}(BTCUSDT)
 How Close Are We?
Estimates have been moving. Older papers put the needed resources in the many millions of qubits. More recent research from groups like Iceberg Quantum suggests the figure could be much lower, perhaps into the six-figure range.
Still, raw qubit counts tell only part of the story. What matters is how many “logical” qubits you can run with acceptable error rates, how long calculations take, and whether the machine can stay stable for that time.
Lab steps by big firms also matter; for example, Google has reported progress in error correction that many found encouraging. That doesn’t mean the break-in is imminent, but it does change risk models.
Where The Industry Stands
Reports note teams are forming to study and build defenses. The Ethereum Foundation has a post-quantum group, and major exchanges and firms are taking part in discussions.
Coinbase set up advisers, and its CEO, Brian Armstrong, has said the problem can be handled with planning. It is “solvable”, he said.

title: BTC Losing Grip: Where Are Smart Money Flows Going?
subTitle:
Hey. Seen the latest ETF data? The numbers aren't just ugly—they're actually worrying. Over the past five weeks, roughly $3.8 billion has flowed out of spot Bitcoin and Ethereum funds. That's the longest stretch of outflows in nearly a year.
Honestly, it's got me thinking. BTC is stuck between $66-68k, failing to break key technical levels. Analysts are whispering about a potential drop to $50k if support cracks. But here's the real twist: capital isn't leaving crypto entirely—it's rotating. While IBIT and FBTC bleed, Solana ETFs pulled in ~$14M, and XRP is quietly grabbing attention too.
We used to believe BTC was digital gold, an inflation hedge. But lately? It didn't play that role. Gold rallied. BTC didn't. Feels like an identity crisis. Payments moved to stablecoins, speculation shifted to prediction markets. So what's left for Bitcoin? Just a "hold and hope" asset?
Institutions are clearly rebalancing. They're not panicking, but they're cautious. Liquidity's thin, sentiment's bearish. That old "BTC only goes up" narrative? It's not automatic anymore. You gotta look broader—toward alts offering real utility or momentum right now.
Bottom line: the market's shifting. Old dogmas are cracking. Investors are chasing growth where it still exists, sidestepping the heavyweights. This isn't crypto's endgame—but it might be the end of BTC's unconditional dominance.
What's your take: temporary correction before the next leg up, or are we actually entering an era where Bitcoin's no longer the undisputed king?

Gas limit significantly increased: Plans to raise the Gas Limit to 100 million or more through EIP-7928, directly boosting L1 throughput. Glamsterdam hard fork: Focus on introducing ePBS (built-in proposer and builder separation mechanism) and increasing the capacity limit of BLOB objects. Statelessness: Transition to a binary tree architecture and clean up expired data, significantly reducing the burden of running nodes.
2️⃣ Brand New UX: Popularization of Smart Accounts
The goal is to make crypto wallets as user-friendly as bank apps:
Native account abstraction: Directly embedding smart contract logic into the protocol's underlying layer through EIP-7701 and EIP-8141. Zero intermediaries: Smart contract wallets will become the standard, operating without middleware and further optimizing Gas consumption.
3️⃣ Protecting Underlying Security (Base Layer)
As the network expands, decentralization and censorship resistance become top priorities. Security and stability will be optimized as independent domains to ensure the bedrock of Ethereum remains unshakeable.
